title: FR-001: Camera config
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Camera config. `cameras.yaml` defines cameras, zones and lines (polygons), blind spots, and topology edges with min and max transit seconds

**Depends on:** none

**Acceptance criteria:** Loader rejects unknown camera or zone references with a named error; `test_config.py` passes

**Blocked by:** nothing (offline-buildable)

Spec: [FR-001](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-002: Clock alignment
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Clock alignment. Each camera gets a time offset measured from one sync event (a hand clap with a phone flash) filmed by all cameras at session start

**Depends on:** FR-001

**Acceptance criteria:** The sync event's aligned times agree within 0.2 s across cameras on every session

**Blocked by:** hardware

Spec: [FR-002](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-003: Privacy at source
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Privacy at source. Fixed polygons are blacked out and audio removed before anything is stored for upload

**Depends on:** FR-001

**Acceptance criteria:** Every pixel inside a polygon is 0 in every output frame; ffprobe finds no audio stream; upload is refused otherwise

**Blocked by:** nothing (offline-buildable)

Spec: [FR-003](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-004: Windowing
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Windowing. Clips are cut into 10 s windows with 2 s overlap, re-encoded to H.264 MP4, 10 fps, at most 1280 px wide, faststart

**Depends on:** FR-002, FR-003

**Acceptance criteria:** Window edges match the plan to one frame; SAM 3.1 accepts every window (no 400)

**Blocked by:** credits

Spec: [FR-004](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-005: Motion gate
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Motion gate. Frame differencing outside masked areas; windows below a per-camera threshold make no model calls

**Depends on:** FR-004

**Acceptance criteria:** On the 12 labelled scenarios, no labelled event falls in a skipped window

**Blocked by:** hardware

Spec: [FR-005](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-006: SAM 3.1 tracking
body:
**Requirement (P0).** SAM 3.1 tracking. Upload each active window once, then one request per noun phrase (`person`, `car`, plus active watches) with confidence; parse with `meta-sam-parser`; cache by request hash

**Depends on:** FR-005

**Acceptance criteria:** Recorded responses parse into tracks; zero matches give an empty result, not an error; a 400 is surfaced with its body

**Blocked by:** credits

Spec: [FR-006](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-007: Track stitching
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Track stitching. IDs are joined across overlapping windows by box overlap (IoU) on shared frames

**Depends on:** FR-006

**Acceptance criteria:** A person crossing 3 windows on one camera is 1 track in the fixture

**Blocked by:** nothing (offline-buildable)

Spec: [FR-007](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-008: Event builder
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Event builder. Emits `enter`, `exit`, `cross`, `touch` (person mask overlaps a protected object), `removed` (watched object disappears while a person overlaps it) and `dwell`; each event has an ID, camera, times, track and clip range

**Depends on:** FR-007, FR-019

**Acceptance criteria:** Synthetic-track unit tests pass; each demo scenario yields its labelled events

**Blocked by:** nothing (offline-buildable)

Spec: [FR-008](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-009: Appearance notes
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Appearance notes. Muse Spark reads a clip with SAM's track tags drawn on it and returns JSON whose tag field is an enum of those tags. Fields: class, upper and lower clothing colour, carried items, vehicle colour and body. No face, age, gender or ethnicity fields exist

**Depends on:** FR-007

**Acceptance criteria:** 100% of responses pass schema validation; an unknown tag is rejected

**Blocked by:** credits

Spec: [FR-009](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-010: Visit assembly
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Visit assembly. Tracks are linked across cameras only when the gap fits a topology edge and the notes agree; two or more candidates means no link

**Depends on:** FR-008, FR-009

**Acceptance criteria:** Link precision at least 90% on the labelled set

**Blocked by:** hardware

Spec: [FR-010](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-011: Gaps
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Gaps. Every interval with a visit's subject out of view is stored with type (`blind_spot`, `ambiguous_link`), times and cameras

**Depends on:** FR-010

**Acceptance criteria:** Scenario C records the shed gap at 41 s, within 1 s of the label

**Blocked by:** hardware

Spec: [FR-011](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-012: Rules engine
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Rules engine. Rule JSON with target, trigger, time window (crossing midnight) and severity, plus 2 default rules: watched package removed; anyone in the backyard 23:00 to 05:00

**Depends on:** FR-008

**Acceptance criteria:** Truth-table tests pass, including windows across midnight

**Blocked by:** nothing (offline-buildable)

Spec: [FR-012](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-013: Triage
body:
**Requirement (P1).** Triage. Code forces escalation when a rule fired, a protected object was touched, or a gap is unresolved; otherwise Spark decides. Visits not escalated get a story built from a template

**Depends on:** FR-012

**Acceptance criteria:** Forced cases always escalate; the escalation rate is reported in EVAL

**Blocked by:** credits

Spec: [FR-013](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-014: Story
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Story. Muse Wonder receives the visit ledger as JSON (no pixels) and returns sentences citing event IDs, a verdict proposal and watch proposals. Gap sentences are written by code, not by the model

**Depends on:** FR-011, FR-013

**Acceptance criteria:** Schema-valid output on all 12 scenarios

**Blocked by:** credits

title: FR-015: Citation validator
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Citation validator. Each sentence cites at least one event in this visit; clock times in the text match a cited event within 60 s; camera names match cited events. Failure triggers one retry with the reasons, then the template

**Depends on:** FR-014

**Acceptance criteria:** Planted bad sentences are all caught; zero uncited sentences ship

**Blocked by:** nothing (offline-buildable)

Spec: [FR-015](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/spec/vigil-spec.md#1-functional-requirements) · Status: [docs/requirements/functional.md](https://github.com/gabrielromerod/meta-global-ai-developer-hackathon-2026/blob/main/docs/requirements/functional.md)

title: FR-016: Verdict
body:
**Requirement (P0).** Verdict. A pure function: rules set the floor; only a rule can produce Needs your attention, and a protected-object touch with no rule gives Noteworthy; an unresolved gap with no rule fired gives Can't confirm; Wonder may raise Normal to Noteworthy, never lower

**Depends on:** FR-012, FR-015

**Acceptance criteria:** Truth-table test covers every combination

**Blocked by:** nothing (offline-buildable)

**Depends on:** FR-016

**Acceptance criteria:** E2E test opens each demo card and finds every element

title: FR-039: 3D position estimates
body:

**Depends on:** FR-037, FR-007

**Acceptance criteria:** Pre-registered accuracy target met or reported as missed; at least 90% of test points inside their stated radius

**Blocked by:** hardware
